commands.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' /codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/references/rule-specs/core-invariants.md && printf '\\n--- state-reactivity ---\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' /codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/references/rule-specs/state-reactivity.md && printf '\\n--- layout-animation-media ---\\n' && sed -n '1,300p' /codex-home/skills/haprepair-openharmony-repair/references/rule-specs/layout-animation-media.md"
/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in $(jq -r '"'.rules[].files[].relative_path' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json | sort -u); do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; nl -ba "$f" | sed -n '"'1,90p'; done"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "for f in entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/index/index.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushNamedRoute/pageOne.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushUrl/page2.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/getStateByIndex/getStateByIndex1.ets; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; nl -ba "$f"; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in $(jq -r '"'.rules[] | select(.rule==\"@performance/hp-arkui-no-state-var-access-in-loop\") | .files[].relative_path' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json); do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; nl -ba "$f" | sed -n '"'15,65p'; done"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '.rules[].files[].relative_path' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json | sort -u | while read -r f; do rg -n '@State|this\\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|for \\(|onClick|Text\\(|Column\\(|Row\\(|Stack\\(' \""'$f"; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '.[] | [.relative_path,.line,.rule] | @tsv' .exp_agent/findings_round_01.json | while IFS="'$'"'\\t' read -r f l r; do printf '%s:%s [%s] ' \""'$f" "$l" "$r"; sed -n "${l}p" "$f"; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in $(jq -r '"'.rules[] | select(.rule==\"@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var\") | .files[].relative_path' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json | sort -u); do printf '%s\\n' \""'$f"; rg -n '"'@State|this\\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\s*=' \""'$f"; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in $(jq -r '"'.rules[] | select(.rule==\"@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var\") | .files[].relative_path' .exp_agent/round_plan_01.json | sort -u); do sed -n '15,80p' \""'$f" | rg -n '"'this\\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\s*=|@State'; done | wc -l"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "printf 'empty callbacks: '; rg -n '\\.onClick\\s*\\(\\(\\)\\s*=>\\s*\\{' entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/index/index.ets || true; printf 'target empty/property-free wrappers: '; rg -n 'Column\\(\\)\\s*\\{' entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushNamedRoute/pageOne.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushUrl/page2.ets || true; printf 'direct state assignments in flagged loops: '; rg -n 'this\\.(text1|str)\\s*=' entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushNamedRoute/pushNamedRoute11.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushNamedRoute/pushNamedRoute15.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushNamedRoute/pushNamedRoute19.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushNamedRoute/pushNamedRoute23.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushNamedRoute/pushNamedRoute3.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushNamedRoute/pushNamedRoute7.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushUrl/pushUrl11.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushUrl/pushUrl15.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushUrl/pushUrl19.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushUrl/pushUrl23.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushUrl/pushUrl3.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushUrl/pushUrl7.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/router/pushUrl/pushUrl8.ets || true"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '{report_rules:(.selected_rules|length), repairs:(.entity_repairs|length), locations:([.entity_repairs[].locations[]]|length), unresolved_external}' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json && jq -e 'all(.entity_repairs[]; .status == \"repaired\" and (.rule|length)>0 and (.relative_path|length)>0 and (.locations|length)>0 and (.entities|length)>0 and (.invariants|length)>0 and (.evidence|length)>0 and (.transformation|length)>0)' .exp_agent/round_completion_01.json"
